ui.language.name: Interface language
ui.language.description: The language of the interface. Follow the system reads LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES and LANG. Takes effect on the next start.

compaction.prepare.name: Pre-compaction
compaction.prepare.description: When the context is nearly full, the older part is summarized in the background, so the switch happens without a wait when compaction is due. Off means compacting only once the limit is reached, as before.

compaction.line.name: Compaction line
compaction.line.description: Compact automatically once the context fills this percent of the window. Small windows keep room for the reply, so compaction may start earlier. With a 200K window, values above 85 have no effect. A 1M window can reach 95.

providers.<id>.name.name: Display name
providers.<id>.name.description: The name people see. The id is only for referring to models; without one, the model data's name for this provider is used, then the id.

providers.<id>.driver.name: Driver
providers.<id>.driver.description: How to talk to this provider. Known providers can leave it out.

providers.<id>.base_url.name: Address
providers.<id>.base_url.description: The address of this provider's API; the driver adds the path. Known providers can leave it out.

providers.<id>.key.name: API key
providers.<id>.key.description: A key typed here is saved in secrets.toml (readable only by you) and the config holds a reference to it; { env = "VARIABLE" } also works. One per provider. Without one, no auth header is sent.

providers.<id>.catalog.name: Catalog provider
providers.<id>.catalog.description: Which provider in the model data this one is, for example deepseek for a relay that only forwards DeepSeek.

providers.<id>.local.name: Local service
providers.<id>.local.description: A model service on this machine. Left out, it follows the address: on this machine means yes.

models.chat.name: Chat model
models.chat.description: The model new sessions use, written as provider/model, for example deepseek/deepseek-flash.

models.vision.name: Vision model
models.vision.description: Looks at images for the chat model when it cannot. Written like the chat model.

tui.keys.name: Key mode
tui.keys.description: Vim: in the session list and the model list, j and k move and / starts a search. Arrow keys: typing searches right away and the arrow keys move.

tui.timeline_fold.name: Auto-fold timeline
tui.timeline_fold.description: Fold the finished steps into one line once the reply is done.

tui.timeline_expand_thought.name: Expand thoughts
tui.timeline_expand_thought.description: Show thoughts in full instead of a preview.

tui.timeline_expand_command.name: Expand commands
tui.timeline_expand_command.description: Show commands in full instead of a preview.

tui.timeline_expand_edit.name: Expand edits
tui.timeline_expand_edit.description: Show edit diffs in full instead of a preview.

tui.timeline_limit_live.name: Timeline area height limit
tui.timeline_limit_live.description: Show only the latest lines of the running steps.

tui.timeline_thought_rows.name: Thought preview rows
tui.timeline_thought_rows.description: How many of the latest lines a thought shows while it runs.

tui.timeline_preview_rows.name: Command preview rows
tui.timeline_preview_rows.description: How many lines of a command the timeline previews.

tui.sidebar_sessions.name: Recent sessions in the sidebar
tui.sidebar_sessions.description: How many sessions the sidebar lists, the current one included. 0 hides the list.

tui.sidebar_jumps.name: Messages to jump to in the sidebar
tui.sidebar_jumps.description: How many of your own messages in this session the sidebar lists, newest at the bottom; click one to jump to it. 0 hides the list.

tui.theme_mode.name: Color mode
tui.theme_mode.description: Follow the terminal's background, or always dark or light.

tui.theme_background.name: Background fill
tui.theme_background.description: Paint the whole screen in the theme's background.

tui.icons.name: Icons
tui.icons.description: Which icon set the terminal interface draws: Nerd Font glyphs, or plain characters for fonts without them.

jobs.max_running.name: Longest background command
jobs.max_running.description: A command the AI runs in the background is stopped after this long, and the AI is told. At most 2 hours.

permission.confirm.timeout.name: Confirmation timeout
permission.confirm.timeout.description: Anything waiting for your confirmation is denied after this many seconds. 0 waits forever.
